structure Fades (K : ℕ → Points n → ℂ) : Prop where
  smooth (k : ℕ) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (K k) (conf n)
  reads (s : Set (Points n)) : IsCompact s → s ⊆ conf n → ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, ∀ t : Test n, tsupport t ⊆ s → (∀ x, ‖t x‖ ≤ M) → ‖t.applyTo (K k)‖ ≤ ε
